Name: Linda
Dialog: I can't believe my baby is 16 and taking her driver's license test!

Name: Girl
Dialog: Why? (sobs)

Name: Girl's mother
Dialog: I can't believe my baby is 16 and failed her driver's license test.

Name: Driving Instructor
Dialog: And another one bites the dust.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Don't worry, sweetie. You've got this!

Name: Linda
Dialog: You know the driver's manual by heart, and your dad and the boys have been helping you parallel park.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (drives back and forth slamming into the two trash cans) Aah! (8x)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, yeah, that was helpful.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, here's your dad. (answers phone and gives it to Candace)

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Hello, just calling to say good luck on your test. Imagine the newfound freedom you'll have if you don't fail! Which, of course, you won't!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Then why are you fixing my bike?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: What-What, this? Oh, no, no, no, no, no, no, I have all the confidence. This is, uh, this is just in case...

Name: Driving Instructor
Dialog: Candace Flynn.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (yelps as Mom's phone jumps out of her grip, Mom catches it)

Name: Linda
Dialog: She's right here!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (to Candace) I'll be waiting over at the park till your test is over. Break a leg, sweetheart! Mwah!

Name: Driving Instructor
Dialog: All right, let's get this over with. (clicks pen)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (groans nervously) Coming.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Whoa! Whatcha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Check it out! Gecko Gear! We got the idea from watching a gecko documentary. They can lick their own eyes.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: But, more importantly, they can climb up walls, which is why we made these gloves and boots from thermoplastic polymers that can stick and re-stick to any surface. Um, 12% more gumminess, Ferb.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nailed it! 12% exactly! Of course, geckos don't have springs, so we added that part.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Grab a set!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We thought it might be fun to take a sticky tour around Danville today. Get out of the yard and stretch our polymers.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (bounces) Let's go! (lands on the roof of the Flynn-Fletcher house) Cool!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ah! Oh! (giggles) My spring may be wound a little too tight.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I've been sayin' that for years.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (panicked yelling)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Follow Baljeet!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yay!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, am I the only one wondering where Perry is?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, hello, Agent P. That portrait turned out great, didn't it?

Name: Carl
Dialog: I left a copy on your desk there, Agent P.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: We clean up pretty nice there, don't we, Agent P? Anyhoo, Doofenshmirtz was up all night tinkering with his car. Now, we know he's not a car guy, so something is up. We've tracked him to the local grocery store. Go check on him, Agent P.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sir, are you flexing your arms in this one?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: No! No, I'm not! And if you happen to be looking for the beach, Carl, (flexes) it's that way.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (chuckles nervously)

Name: Driving Instructor
Dialog: Start the car.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay. Start the car. (She bumps her head on the overhead mirror.) Ow! Whoops. (giggles)

Name: Driving Instructor
Dialog: Longer sustained movements are preferable.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, hello, Perry the Platypus! You shop here, too? Do you need a basket? (laughs)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Funny, I've never thought about you shopping. Aw, your little cart with your little groceries! You're... You're a complete mystery to me. You can relate to this big problem I have. Don't you hate it when you get stuck in traffic coming home from the store and you have ice cream and other perishables? Don't ask why I don't have any bags. Anyway, then everything starts melting and... hold on.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes, of course, I return the cart. I'm evil, not a monster. Anyway, behold the Red-Green-Shift-inator! It can turn street lights from red to green, and get me home before my groceries get grosser...ies. There's... There's something in there. I'll... I'll workshop it later. Anyway, I simply press this button, and switcharooney!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Look, I know what you're thinking. This could be dangerous with traffic and all. But have you had room temperature tuna, Perry the Platypus? That's the real danger. That's the collapse of society right there.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, things are a-thawin'. Toodles!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, I know you want me to go left, but can't I technically make three rights to make a left? I mean, I know two wrongs don't make a right, but three rights do make a left, right?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (hitting her head on the steering wheel) Ugh.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey! There's Candace taking her test! Go, Candace!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You got this!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Go, Candace! You got this, girl!

Name: Buford
Dialog: You got this, Candace! Don't get nervous and make a series of bad decisions that cause you to fail your driver's test and haunt ya for the rest of yer life!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Buford!

Name: Buford
Dialog: What? I told her not to do that!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb, I am busting your biscuits!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (to the instructor) Buckle up, dude, it's about to get real!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Park! Mom!

Name: Bus driver
Dialog: Oh!

Name: Mover 1
Dialog: (lets go) Phew!

Name: Mover 2
Dialog: (grunts)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, get in!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Uh... okay.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You gotta see what the boys are doing! I'm hot on their trail!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus! Yes, yes, I've acquired a few more things that need to get somewhere fast. There's an expectant mother, a magician holding his breath, and an ice sculpture of a pregnant magician holding her breath. Don't ask. It's been a weird day. Perry the Platypus, I'm not even breaking any laws, the lights are green. You're trying to get me to break the law. This is entrapment!

Name: Hipster
Dialog: Pesto? I ordered marinara!

Name: Woman 1
Dialog: Summer's great, but fall's my favorite.

Name: Man 1
Dialog: It's always about you, isn't it, Janice?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey! Cool hair!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Back atcha!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Good luck! Heinz is a great name. For a boy or a girl, I'm just saying! Isn't that lovely, Perry the Platypus?

Name: Driving Instructor
Dialog: And you'll finish ups by parallel parking right over there.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, no! What's going on?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The Gecko Gear is getting dirty and losing its stick.

Name: The gang
Dialog: (screaming)

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'll be right back!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (panting) Wait! Where are your stick hand thingies? I gotta show Mom!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We were done. They're right over there. Wait, how did the test go?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (clasps her hands and giggles evily before leaving)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (caresses Perry) I hope I'm insured for thiiiiiiiiiiis!

Name: Woman 2
Dialog: (gasps) A pregnant magician? You remembered our first date!

Name: Buford
Dialog: You guys get ice cream? (A pork loin lands in his hands.) Pork loin? Eh, I can work wit' dat.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry!

Name: Perry
Dialog: (chatters)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Curse you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Mom! Mom! But but but but...

Name: Linda
Dialog: I don't understand what has gotten into you, Candace.

Name: Driving Instructor
Dialog: Miss Flynn-Fletcher?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I know. I'll be riding my bike till I'm 35.

Name: Driving Instructor
Dialog: Well, if that's what you choose. But you can also drive a car. You passed.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I did?

Name: Linda
Dialog: That's wonderful, honey!

Name: Driving Instructor
Dialog: In the face of the craziest traffic, I have never seen more alert and focused driving in all my life. This is the thrill I've been waiting for! By the way, I have two sisters I always wanted to bust.

Name: Sisters
Dialog: And you never will get us, Brian!

Name: Brian
Dialog: Mother, you have got to see what the girls are doing! But but but but...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Congratulations, Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Thanks, guys! Okay, who wants to go for a ride?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Wait a second, did you guys do something with your hair?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You like it?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, that you notice?

Name: Candace
Dialog: The thing they used to build these things is still in the backyard. Come on!

Name: Candace
Dialog: But but but...

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, you did such a great job driving us all home!
